{"markdown": "## Question
Which mechanism best explains the loss of function of CTLA4 p.Arg70Trp (UniProt P16410), and can one targeted computational test check it?

## Evidence
ClinVar records the variant as Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic, with criteria provided and no conflicts [E1]. UniProt lists the R70W natural variant [E2] and annotates residue 70 as a mutagenesis site with strongly reduced interaction with CD80, CD86 and ICOSLG [E3]. Residue 70 lies in the extracellular Ig-V domain [E7, E9] and in a beta-strand segment spanning residues 68 to 77 [E10]. Three crystal structures observe residue 70 in CTLA-4 complexes [E17, E18, E19], but none carries the substitution [G5]. An IntAct record links CTLA-4 to CD80 but does not map the interface to residues [E20, G6]. Computational predictions are mixed and unvalidated: AlphaMissense 0.4657, ambiguous [E12]; EVE 0.583, uncertain [E15]; popEVE -4.977 [E14]; conservation 1.0 [E16]. Literature reports impaired transendocytosis for 17 of 24 variants, but R70W is not named [E4]. No retrieved paper reports the effect of R70W on binding, trafficking or stability [G1].

## Agent-generated hypotheses
The agent-generated hypotheses are H1, a protein-interaction defect at the CD80/CD86 contact (rank 1) [H1]; H2, a stability or folding defect (rank 2) [H2]; and H3, a trafficking or retention defect (rank 3) [H3]. H1 was favoured before the test.

## Tests considered and the choice
The planner chose T1, a FoldX ddG stability test with zero compute seconds, to separate H2 from H1 and H3 [T1]. It rejected T2 (structural context), T3 (ligand contact) and T4 (structure comparison, which needs approval and has feasibility 0.1) [T2, T3, T4].

## Updated decision
Favoured before the test: H1. Favoured after: H1, still untested. Decision changed: no. The choice of T1 was not executed, so no result weakened H1.

## Uncertainty and validation still needed
Nothing has been validated experimentally. The predictions in [E12, E14, E15, E16] are computational only. It is unknown whether residue 70 contacts CD80 or CD86 [G6], whether R70W changes folding or surface expression [G1], and whether it acts as a loss of function or a dominant-negative change [G3]. The structure record shows no R70W structure [G5].

## Next experiment
Run T1, the FoldX ddG stability test, once safety clears the flagged claim wording [seq 22, seq 47, seq 48, seq 51, seq 52, seq 53]. Safety noted this may be a false positive, so a human may wish to confirm."}
